Label: Glucose
Note: Hexose isomers (galactose, mannose, fructose) share the formula; confirm by RT.

Label: G6P
Note: Hexose-phosphate isomers (F6P, M6P, G1P) share the formula.

Label: M6P
Note: Hexose-phosphate isomer; separation from G6P/F6P not guaranteed.

Label: Ru5P
Note: Pentose-phosphate isomers (R5P, Xu5P) share the formula.

Label: Citrate
Note: Isocitrate has the same formula; usually separated chromatographically.

Label: α-KG
Synonyms: alpha-Ketoglutarate|alpha-Ketoglutaric acid|2-Oxoglutaric acid|α-Ketoglutaric acid|2-Ketoglutaric acid|Oxoglutaric acid

Label: Fumarate
Note: Maleate (cis isomer) has the same formula.

Label: Asp-4P
Note: Not a typical mammalian metabolite; check annotation.

Label: Phe
Note: Essential amino acid: not made from glucose.

Label: Hippurate
Note: Benzoate conjugate; largely diet/microbiome-derived in vivo.

Label: Inosine
Note: Allopurinol riboside has the same formula.

Label: UMP
Note: 3'- and 5'-UMP share the formula; the cellular pool is mainly 5'-UMP.

Label: UDP-Gal
Note: UDP-glucose has the same formula; usually co-elute.

Label: Neu5Gc
Note: Not made by human cells; usually taken up from serum.

Label: C2-carnitine
Note: Acetyl group can carry glucose-derived carbon (M+2).

Label: Pantothenate
Note: Vitamin; not synthesized by human cells.
